reuse.why: Extends the shared getExpectedScheduleAmount, but re-implements the 7.5% tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts that rule matching uses.

duplication.why: Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) is a copy of getApproxNumberThreshold, so the tolerance now has two definitions that must stay equal.

placement.why: The rule change is in shared/schedules.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount, where the expected-amount rule lives.

scope.why: Only the helper, three call sites and its tests.

maintainability.why: An optional op parameter that some callers pass and others (api-models expectedAmount, forecast-schedules) silently omit, plus a duplicated tolerance constant, leaves the approximate rule inconsistent and easy to miss.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts inlines the tolerance instead of getApproxNumberThreshold; server/api-models.ts and server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts keep calling getExpectedScheduleAmount without the operator, bypassing the new rule.

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance formula is a verbatim inline copy of getApproxNumberThreshold, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The rule is in getExpectedScheduleAmount, but it only applies where callers pass op: schedules/app.ts (two sites) and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions do, api-models.ts and forecast-schedules.ts do not, and the tolerance itself is defined both there and in getApproxNumberThreshold.
